brand.beakbound.note: Brand stays in Latin letters (BEAKBOUND in the logo).

char.peaches.note: Phonetic (Bìqí, ~"Peachy"); soft feminine characters. Her peach puns use 桃/蜜桃 in the line, the name stays 碧琪.

char.minty.note: Phonetic (Mǐndì); 敏 = quick, 弟 = little brother: a cocky little boy. Mint jokes use 薄荷 in the line.

char.postmaster-bill.note: Name 比爾 + title 局長 (Chinese puts the title after the name). Short form 比爾.

char.courier.note: Everyday Taiwanese word for a mail carrier; gender-neutral. Royal Courier 皇家郵差, Courier Pip 郵差皮普.

char.narrator.note: Never named on screen; gentle storybook narration addressing the player with 你.

boss.baron-bat.note: Chinese order (species + rank). Short forms: 男爵; address 男爵 / 男爵大人.

boss.spitter-king.note: King of the 噴噴甲蟲 (spitter beetles); reduplicated 噴噴 is playful and kid-friendly. Bill: 國王; birds: 陛下.

boss.dusk-empress.note: Same 暮光 as the dusk moths (暮光蛾). Short form 女皇; Her Highness 女皇殿下. Self-reference 本宮.

boss.pirate-captain.note: Short form 船長; he calls himself 本船長.

boss.ember-dragon.note: 餘燼 = embers (same word as the attack 餘燼). Short form 巨龍; letter: 親愛的巨龍.

guardian.neferhoo.note: Phonetic NEF-er-hoo (Nàifúhú); Mister Neferhoo 奈弗胡先生. Self-reference 老夫 (fussy old official).

guardian.king-coo.note: Adapted: 咕咕 is the Chinese pigeon coo, 王 = king; short for the card. He calls himself 本警長.

guardian.searchlight-gargoyle.note: Card split: 探照燈 / 石像鬼. Short form 石像鬼; self-reference in the job line: 本石像鬼.

npc.toucan-twins.note: Toucan = 巨嘴鳥 (Taiwan usage); plural, giggly.

npc.firefly-nursery.note: A place for little ones (not a plant nursery).

npc.samba-macaws.note: Macaw = 金剛鸚鵡; samba = 森巴 (Taiwan).

npc.caravan-leader.note: Leader of the camel caravan (駱駝商隊).

npc.night-cabbies.note: Short form 夜班司機; cargo uses the same words.

npc.baker.note: The Paris baker (feminine); not the volcano baker.

npc.storm-watch.note: Cargo: 風暴守望隊的水手 (storm-watch sailors).

npc.rooftop-runners.note: Rooftop racers; 飛毛腿 = speedy runner (Taiwan idiom).

npc.sphinx.note: Taiwan name of the Sphinx; as a character 人面獅身 (Mister Sphinx = 人面獅身先生); masculine.

npc.unit-7.note: Robot serial name in the anime style (cf. 初號機).

npc.baron-cousins.note: Cousins! = 表親們！; Relatives! = 親戚們！

title.postmaster.note: Head of the post office (郵局局長); after the name: 比爾局長. "Postmaster's orders" = 局長的命令.

title.the-storm-returns.note: Echoes 風暴之主; headline THE BARON RETURNS = 男爵回來了.

title.keeper-of-the-twilight-veil.note: 薄紗 = the veil (fight hints use the same word).

title.keeper-of-lost-letters.note: The club job (plural, all lost mail); echoes the card epithet.

title.royal-courier.note: Same 郵差 as char.courier (Pip: 皇家郵差？我只是郵差。).

title.commissioner-of-the-curb.note: Adapted: a pompous street police title (curb = 街角, where pigeons peck).

title.commissioner.note: Police chief; self-reference 本警長; job ad 徵警長一名. Not 局長 (that is Bill).

region.open-sea.note: The high seas, nowhere to land; 公海 is too legal.

region.cyberpunk-city.note: 電馭叛客 is the established Taiwan term for cyberpunk; Bill calls it 霓虹城 (the neon city).

place.city-of-light.note: The usual Chinese epithet of Paris.

place.edge-of-the-map.note: Same words as chapter 5 and the achievement.

place.sugarloaf-mountain.note: The Chinese name (麵包山 / 糖麵包山) keeps the sugar, so Pip's joke survives.

place.theatre-marquee.note: The lit canopy over the theatre door; 簷 (eaves) is where you shelter from rain.

chapter.canopy-route.note: 航線 = route (birds fly it); the key recurring route word.

chapter.ancient-road.note: The Spitter King's 我的古道 / 我路上.

level.1-5.note: Taiwan Post's real name for express mail; same as Neferhoo's EXPRESS POST.

level.2-2.note: Blocked with stone; not the flame seal.

level.2-8.note: Cargo: 給漫漫商隊的水壺.

level.3-1.note: Moths chasing light (nod to 飛蛾撲火 without the dark meaning).

level.3-3.note: Bill says it aloud: 下一站，菜鳥：蒸氣巷.

level.3-7.note: Midnight + express (cf. the film 午夜快車).

level.4-5.note: The Chinese nautical term for a spring tide.

level.5-4.note: Taiwan uses 資料 for data.

level.5-5.note: Same 衝刺 as the Sprint button.

level.5-6.note: The established name of the Lantern Festival.

level.5-7.note: Taiwan idiom for the final stretch.

cargo.1-1.en: A birthday card for the toucan twins
cargo.1-1.target: 給巨嘴鳥雙胞胎的生日卡

cargo.1-2.en: Star charts for the sloth stargazer

cargo.1-3.target: 給螢火蟲幼兒園的小夜燈

cargo.1-4.en: Feather boas for the carnival parade
cargo.1-4.target: 給嘉年華遊行的羽毛圍巾

cargo.1-5.en: A rush invitation for the drum captain
cargo.1-5.target: 給鼓隊隊長的緊急邀請函

cargo.1-6.en: Cocoa beans for the temple cooks

cargo.1-7.en: A sundial for the dawn keeper

cargo.1-8.en: A final notice for Baron Bat
cargo.1-8.target: 給蝙蝠男爵的最後通知
cargo.1-8.note: 最後通知 = the formal final notice.

cargo.2-1.en: Laurel wreaths for the chariot racers

cargo.2-2.en: A new chisel for the statue carver

cargo.2-3.en: Water buckets for the fire brigade

cargo.2-4.en: A book of new riddles for the Sphinx
cargo.2-4.target: 給人面獅身的新謎語書

cargo.2-5.en: A telescope for the pyramid astronomer
cargo.2-5.target: 給金字塔天文學家的望遠鏡

cargo.2-6.en: A feather duster for the caretaker
cargo.2-6.note: Feather duster = 雞毛撢子 (the everyday Taiwanese word).

cargo.2-7.en: Lamp oil for the lantern sellers

cargo.2-8.en: Water flasks for the long caravan

cargo.2-9.en: A stop-brewing order for the Spitter King

cargo.3-1.en: Light bulbs for the theatre marquee

cargo.3-3.en: Hot pretzels for the night-shift cabbies
cargo.3-3.target: 給夜班司機的熱椒鹽捲餅

cargo.3-4.en: A weather vane for the tallest tower

cargo.3-6.en: Sheet music for the accordion player

cargo.3-7.en: A midnight love letter for the baker
cargo.3-7.target: 給麵包師傅的午夜情書

cargo.3-8.en: A wake-up call for the Dusk Empress
cargo.3-8.note: 起床號 = a wake-up call (signal and warning).

cargo.4-1.en: A new lens for the lighthouse keeper
cargo.4-1.target: 給燈塔看守人的新鏡片

cargo.4-2.en: Oven mitts for the volcano baker
cargo.4-2.target: 給火山烘焙師的隔熱手套

cargo.4-3.en: Kite string for the beach festival

cargo.4-4.en: A reply for the island hermit

cargo.4-5.en: A tide table for the ferry crew

cargo.4-6.en: Fish biscuits for the gull colony

cargo.4-7.en: Dry socks for the storm-watch sailors
cargo.4-7.target: 給風暴守望隊水手的乾襪子

cargo.4-8.en: A return-the-mail order for the Captain
cargo.4-8.note: An order to return the mail.

cargo.5-1.en: Woolly hats for the penguin choir
cargo.5-1.target: 給企鵝合唱團的毛線帽

cargo.5-2.en: Hot cocoa for the polar station
cargo.5-2.target: 給極地研究站的熱可可

cargo.5-3.en: Spare fuses for the noodle bar sign
cargo.5-3.target: 給麵館招牌的備用保險絲

cargo.5-4.en: A paper letter for a curious robot
cargo.5-4.target: 給好奇機器人的紙本信

cargo.5-5.en: Race tickets for the rooftop runners
cargo.5-5.target: 給屋頂飛毛腿的比賽門票

cargo.5-8.en: The first letter ever sent to the Dragon

enemy.spitter-beetle.note: Same 噴噴 as the king.

enemy.dusk-moth.note: Same 暮光 as the Empress.

enemy.straggler.note: Not printed; the UI says 它會回來.

enemy.brood.note: His beetles; he calls them 我的小聖甲蟲們.

enemy.empress-moths.note: Her pet names: 我的小可愛們, 我的美人們, 我的小甜心們.

attack.screech.note: Bill's 他光會尖叫 uses the same 尖叫.

attack.fan.note: Short: 扇形; fans of three = 三發扇形.

attack.veil.note: The birds may call it 護盾 (shield); same object.

attack.dragon-breath.note: Its glowing heart = 心臟 (not the 愛心 pickup).

attack.embers.note: Same root as 餘燼巨龍.

attack.lamp.note: The Gargoyle's chest lamp; 燈 for short.

attack.mail-call.note: Neferhoo's cry 來信囉！ = handing out the mail.

attack.ankh.note: Standard Chinese name of the ankh.

hazard.gate.note: Counted with 道 (三道完美的門); gap/opening = 縫隙 / 開口.

hazard.switchback.note: Up one gap, down the next.

hazard.steam-geyser.note: Hot / soft = 燙的 / 軟的; hop / ride = 跳過 / 乘著.

hazard.tide.note: HIGH TIDE = 滿潮; TIDE RISING = 漲潮了.

set-piece.rush-path.note: A short perilous dash; HUD 急襲 ×2！

set-piece.skyfall.note: Coined: meteors falling from the sky.

set-piece.vanguard.note: Not shown; the banner names the group.

pickup.star.note: One word for pickup, rating and currency.

pickup.heart.note: The life heart; Peaches plays on it.

pickup.sprint-ring.note: Hints and voices: 金環 (gold rings).

weapon.shoot.note: Button and verb in hints (點射擊 / 按住射擊).

weapon.rock.note: The jokes keep 石頭 (rock-paper-scissors, sticks and stones).

mode.endless.note: Adjective: 無盡的 (endless flight 無盡飛行).

mode.tap-and-fly.note: Pattern X飛行 shared by the four control modes.

ui.sky-club-post.note: As the door greeting: 天空俱樂部郵局！

ui.passport-stamp.note: Ink stamp; never 郵票 (postage stamp).

ui.gold.note: Medal: 金牌; gold rings 金環.

ui.star-marks.note: The notches on the star track; Pip's "top notch" pun is adapted.

ui.flight.note: One play session = 一趟飛行.

ui.collection.note: "Meet your flight crew." = 認識你的飛行夥伴。

ui.hint.note: Taiwanese for a handy tip; Bill's tip = 比爾的小撇步.

ui.postcard.note: Dear courier, = 親愛的郵差：; P.S. = 附註：

ui.bonk.note: Cartoon bump; the Empress's 咚。咚。 uses the same sound.

ui.story-key.note: Skip = 跳過; Next line = 下一句.

ui.to-be-continued.note: Exact caption start: 未完待續……

ui.pace.note: Relaxed / Steady / Brisk = 悠閒 / 穩定 / 輕快.

ui.home-greeting.target: 嗨，我是$name！準備好起飛了嗎？

achievement.star-chaser.note: Pun: a star chaser is also a fan.

achievement.flock-together.note: The Chinese idiom for birds of a feather.

achievement.out-of-the-spotlight.note: Escaping his beam and the ham losing the spotlight.

achievement.bright-lights.note: The bright lights of the big city.

achievement.goal-open-horizons.note: Idiom: wide open sea and sky.

story.flame-seal.note: The flame-shaped wax seal; "seal" alone = 封印.

story.warm-letter.note: 溫暖 is both warm to the touch and kind.

story.mail-route.note: The one route word (五條航線, 送信航線).

story.beacon.note: A signal fire: fits a dragon. 來看守我們的烽火吧。

story.pigeonholes.note: Pun adapted: the club "never had a 信鴿 (carrier pigeon)".

story.bread-cart.note: 麵包車 alone means a minivan in Chinese, hence 推車.

story.brew.note: His bubbling potion; to brew = 熬.

story.letter-phrases.note: 此致敬禮 is the classic Chinese letter closing every child learns (replaces the postcard cliché); also 「早日康復」 (get well soon), 「愛你的」 (love from).

story.wake-up-call.note: Both the wake-up signal and a warning.

story.first-letter.en: the first letter ever sent to the Dragon

story.dotted-i.en: He dotted his “i” with a tiny bat.
story.dotted-i.target: 名字旁還畫了隻小蝙蝠。
story.dotted-i.note: Adapted: Chinese has no dotted i, so the bat sits beside his signature.

story.pharaohs-post.note: In the line: 法老的信.

story.headwear.note: Crown 王冠, flask crown 燒瓶王冠, diadem 后冠, hat 帽子, cap 警帽.

motto.every-letter-lands.note: Built on the well-known slogan 使命必達: every letter (封) will surely arrive. Works as a question: 真的封封必達嗎？ Written 封封必達。 as a sentence.

address.rookie.note: The usual Taiwanese word for a newbie, and literally a bird.

address.postie.note: Salty colloquial "the mail guy", gender-neutral (郵差仔 avoided: TTS may misread 仔).

address.skylubber.note: 旱鴨子 = landlubber (a duck who cannot swim) + 飛天.

address.little-spark.note: A spark (also Mars, a little star-like pun).

address.little-one.note: The Empress's lullaby address; little wanderer 小流浪者, night bird 夜鳥.

address.mister.note: After the name: 奈弗胡先生, 人面獅身先生.

address.peaches-pet-names.note: Varied, never twice in a row; used so far: 小可愛 (cutie), 蜜糖 (sugar), 親愛的 (darling), 寶貝 (honey), 甜心 (darling), 小蛋糕 (honeybun), 小布丁 (lovebug), 小餅乾 (buttercup), 小棉花糖 (poppet). Spare: 小南瓜, 小糖果, 乖寶寶, 甜甜圈.

address.minions.en: Cousins! / my lovelies / my little scarabs / me hearties
address.minions.target: 表親們！／我的小可愛們／我的小聖甲蟲們／小的們

phrase.baron-bat-line.en: This route is my roost now, little courier!
phrase.baron-bat-line.target: 這條航線現在是我的窩了，小郵差！

phrase.spitter-king-line.en: Every letter on my road goes in the brew!
phrase.spitter-king-line.target: 我路上的每封信，通通下鍋熬！

phrase.dusk-empress-line.en: Hush now. The night mail is sleeping.

phrase.pirate-captain-line.en: Arr! Every mailbag on these waves be mine!
phrase.pirate-captain-line.target: 呀哈！海上的郵袋，全歸本船長！

phrase.ember-dragon-line.en: The sky is mine. Your letters are kindling.
phrase.ember-dragon-line.target: 天空是我的。你們的信，只是柴火。

phrase.neferhoo-line.en: Return to sender! This route has a courier.
phrase.neferhoo-line.target: 退回寄件人！這條航線有郵差了。

phrase.king-coo-line.en: Nobody flies till the bread cart is found!
phrase.king-coo-line.target: 麵包推車沒找到，誰都不准飛！

phrase.searchlight-gargoyle-line.en: Hold still! Nobody ever stays in the light.
phrase.searchlight-gargoyle-line.target: 別動！從來沒人肯待在光裡。

phrase.return-to-sender.note: The returned-mail formula; prop split 退回 / 寄件人.

phrase.signed-sealed-delivered.note: Three beats; Minty: 蓋章、封口、咻一下！

phrase.peaches-tagline.en: Rosy cheeks, curly crest, all heart.
phrase.peaches-tagline.target: 粉嫩臉頰、捲捲羽冠、滿滿愛心。

phrase.minty-tagline.en: Tiny hummer. Fresh sprig. Full speed.
phrase.minty-tagline.target: 小小蜂鳥，清新薄荷，全速衝刺。

phrase.orbit-tagline.en: A dreamy owl who flies by starlight.
phrase.orbit-tagline.target: 乘著星光飛翔的愛睏小貓頭鷹。
phrase.orbit-tagline.note: Bill: 跟著星光飛吧，菜鳥。

phrase.keep-your-beak-up.note: Twist of 抬頭挺胸 (chin up, chest out) with 喙 (beak).

phrase.no-flame-seal.en: No flame seal on this guardian.
phrase.no-flame-seal.target: 這位守護者沒有火焰封印。

phrase.mister-nice-bat.note: Twist of 別怪我不客氣.

phrase.mind-the-gap.note: Taiwan MRT platform announcement (注意月台間隙).

phrase.sticks-and-stones.note: No Chinese proverb fits; the joke keeps the stones: 我可是真的帶了石頭！

phrase.pirate-speak.note: Stage pirate: 呀哈！ 喲呵！ 站住！ 我的船錨啊！ 本船長, 小的們, 送信的.

phrase.nobody-looks-up.note: Payoff: 每個郵差都會抬頭看！

ui.omen-spitter.note: 醞釀 = brewing, literally and figuratively.

story.letter.note: One word everywhere, as in 封封必達 (封 = measure word for letters).

story.mail-and-post.note: Mail = 郵件 / 信; the postal service = 郵局 / 郵政.

story.delivery.note: Deliver 送, delivery 送件 / 送信, delivered 送達.

ui.star-multiplier-callout.note: UI: callout {n}× 星星倍率！ and the replay moment. Kept apart from pickup.star-power 星星無敵 (the duel invincibility). (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.star-points.note: Endless score label; unit after a number: 星星分 (42 星星分). (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.obstacles-score.note: Old Classic course score label; unit 道門. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.health.note: Screen-reader health; on-canvas labels keep HP (剩餘 120 HP). (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.charge.note: Shot: 蓄力; meters that refill: 充能中. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.home-button.note: Back-home key; tooltip 回主畫面. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.new-tag.note: Level card / results / bird ribbons. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.personal-best.note: Team: 團隊最佳 / 團隊新紀錄！ (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.first-clear.note: Built levels: 你已破關 = cleared by you (glossary ui.cleared-by-you). (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.save-session.note: Same as the saved-session list 已存的飛行. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.in-view.note: Camera coaching: 讓雙肩保持入鏡. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.camera.note: 鏡頭 in game UI (鏡頭與追蹤實驗室, 啟動鏡頭); 相機 only for the Android permission (相機權限). (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.body-hip.note: Also 肩膀 / 手肘 / 手腕 / 膝蓋 / 雙腳. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.key-names.en: Space / Esc / D / A / W keys; Up / Right / Left arrows
ui.key-names.target: Space 鍵 / Esc 鍵 / D 鍵 …；上鍵 / 右鍵 / 左鍵
ui.key-names.note: Latin key caps kept, followed by 鍵. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.builder-fix-it.note: Level Builder shelf key and badge. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.builder-remix-suffix.note: 「花園跳跳 改編版」, 「我的點擊關卡 副本」. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.builder-tips.note: Problems = 問題; not 小撇步 (that is the level card TIP). (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.builder-motion.target: 動態 / 擺動 / 外觀 / 開口
ui.builder-motion.note: Still / Gentle / Lively = 靜止 / 輕柔 / 活潑; Fast / Medium / Slow = 快 / 中 / 慢. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.paste-code.note: Uses ui.share-code 分享碼. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.maker.note: Cleared by its maker = 作者已破關. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.copilot.note: Birds screen pill. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.greetings-from.note: Postcard address: 郵差 收 / 天空俱樂部郵局 / 高高的天上. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.vanguard-left.note: Read as 3 隻還在; CLEAR! = 全清！ (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.neferhoo-roar.note: 嗚呼 is an old-fashioned 'alas!', fitting the fussy mummy official; 咕咕 stays the pigeon's. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.weathered.target: 撐過了！ / 逃脫！ / 完美無傷！
ui.weathered.note: Gale and rush banners. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)

ui.all-rings.target: 金環全拿！ / 渦輪加速
ui.all-rings.note: Glossary pickup.sprint-ring: 金環 in hints. (added by the UI translator, 2026-10-07)
